using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using Ferrule.Generated;
using Ferrule.Runtime;

var cases = JsonNode.Parse(File.ReadAllText(args[0]))!.AsArray();
var sourceSchema = File.ReadAllText(args[1]);
var targetSchema = File.ReadAllText(args[2]);
foreach (var index in new[] { 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 2, 0, 3, 1, 4 })
{
    var test = cases[index]!;
    var text = test["input"]!.ToJsonString();
    var source = FerruleJson.ParseEmbedded(sourceSchema, text);
    var before = FerruleJson.SerializeEmbedded(sourceSchema, source);
    var actual = GeneratedMapping.Execute(source);
    var json = FerruleJson.SerializeEmbedded(targetSchema, actual);
    if (!JsonNode.DeepEquals(JsonNode.Parse(json), test["expected"]))
        throw new InvalidOperationException("Complete output mismatch: " + json + " expected " + test["expected"]);
    var after = FerruleJson.SerializeEmbedded(sourceSchema, source);
    if (before != after || !JsonNode.DeepEquals(JsonNode.Parse(after), test["input"]))
        throw new InvalidOperationException("Changed input: " + test["id"]);
    Console.WriteLine(test["id"] + ": " + json);
}
